headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.5.27-modder.86
summary: Disables the ANR watchdog whose thread dump froze the whole process for seconds on low-RAM devices and could force-exit the game mid-session.

items.text: Disabled the xCrash fork's ANR watchdog: its dump suspended every thread for seconds (full-process freeze on low-RAM devices) and the ANR callback force-exited the game via MainActivity when it fired mid-session. Java and native crash handlers remain enabled.
